meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh. Navigate web pages, interact with elements using @e refs, take screenshots, record video. Capabilities: web scraping, form filling, clicking, typing, drag-drop, file upload, JavaScript execution. Use for: web automation, data extraction, testing, agent browsing, research. Triggers: browser, web automation, scrape, navigate, click, fill form, screenshot, browse web, playwright, headless browser, web agent, surf internet, record video

copy.tagline: 用自然语言控制浏览器完成点击、填表、截图等操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要让AI自动操作网页完成重复任务
copy.tagline_en: Control browser with natural language to click, fill forms, take screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need AI to automate repetitive web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动操控浏览器：打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、录制视频，还能执行 JavaScript 代码。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 浏览网页、填写表单、抓取数据或录制浏览器操作时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开网页并返回截图。

say.text: 在百度搜索“天气”并截图
say.note: Claude 会打开百度、输入搜索词、截图。

say.text: 录制登录 example.com 的过程
say.note: Claude 会录制视频并返回文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser: open web pages, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, record video, and execute JavaScript.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to browse the web, fill forms, scrape data, or record browser sessions.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and return a screenshot.
Claude will open Google, type the query, and screenshot.

say_en.text: Record the login process on example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will record a video and return the file.
